hooks.no_website: No active website listed in map directories — exploratory query: does the business rely on word-of-mouth or seek new local clients?
hooks.suspect_corporate: Corporate entity without website in OSM — website likely exists outside map directory (verify online prior to calling).
hooks.broken_website: Company website ({url}) is unreachable or returning an error ({issue}) — prospective local customers cannot reach them.
hooks.social_only: Only relies on a {platform} page — customers without an account or via Google search struggle to reach them.
hooks.directory_only: Only listed in a directory ({platform}) — lacks a dedicated online presence.
hooks.http_only: Website lacks HTTPS — modern browsers flag the site as insecure.
hooks.no_viewport: Website is not mobile-responsive (missing viewport) — unreadable on modern phones.
hooks.outdated_tech: Outdated site technology ({generator}) — would benefit from modern redesign.
hooks.missing_impressum: Missing owner details / Impressum — clear company info builds trust with prospective customers.
hooks.reviews_no_site: Has public customer reviews but lacks a dedicated website to showcase offerings.
hooks.hot_prospect: High-priority lead: local business with contact info needing a modern website.

messages.no_leads: No businesses found matching criteria within selected radius.
messages.no_leads_tip: Tips: 1) Increase radius (--radius 25), 2) Check another vertical (brakstrony list-verticals), 3) Verify city spelling.
